issues.description: Module header comment still says 'Supports both JSON plans (steps with acceptance criteria, behavioral contract) and legacy markdown plans (phases with step counts)' but only JSON plans are now supported. The PhaseSummaryItem type and phases field in PlanSummaryDisplay are also stale (always empty array). Non-blocking since code compiles and works correctly.

State tracking now defaults to empty completedSteps and currentStepIndex=0 with a comment 'no longer parsed from .state.md files'. This is correct for the deletion, but means the dispatcher always sees step 0 as current regardless of actual queue progress. This appears to be a pre-existing limitation of the JSON plan migration, not a bug introduced by this feature.
